perilsBands.description:
You take 1d6 psychic damage and cannot take reactions 
until your next turn.
perilsBands.name: Warp Static

perilsBands.description:
You take 2d6 psychic damage and are blinded until the 
end of your next turn.
perilsBands.name: Bleeding Eyes

perilsBands.description:
Every creature within 10 ft of you, including you, takes 
2d6 psychic damage.
perilsBands.name: Soul Echo

perilsBands.description:
Creatures of your choice within 30 ft must make a 
Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they become
frightened until the end of their next turn.
You are not automatically exempt from this effect.
perilsBands.name: Warp Scream

perilsBands.description:
You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn as 
something presses against your mind.
perilsBands.name: Possession Pressure

perilsBands.description:
The GM chooses a random psychic power you know. It 
immediately targets a random valid creature or
location.
perilsBands.name: Uncontrolled Manifestation

perilsBands.description:
A 10-ft radius area within 30 ft becomes warped terrain 
for 1 minute.
A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn 
or starts its turn there takes 2d6 force
damage.
perilsBands.name: Reality Tear

perilsBands.description:
You drop to 0 hit points. Every creature within 30 ft takes 
4d6 psychic damage.
A hostile Warp entity, hallucination, corruption event, 
daemon sign, or possession threat enters the
scene.
After resolving Catastrophic Perils, the character gains 1 
Corruption.
perilsBands.name: Catastrophic Perils
